# generator-shortcuts

**Strongest plausible tested rival:** fill each empty cell before the wall from the nearest active source to its left, rather than preserving ownership by the first source encountered. This rival fits all four usable canonical labeled pairs (three demonstrations and the labeled test), not merely a convenient subset.

**Exact input**
```text
00000050
00500050
30056050
00000056
00000050
```

**Racket output**
```text
00000050
00500050
33356350
00000056
00000050
```

**Nearest-source rival output**
```text
00000050
00500050
33356650
00000056
00000050
```

Coordinates are zero-based. At (2,5), Racket produces 3; the rival produces 6. The original 6 at (2,4), isolated gray 5 at (2,3), full wall at column 6 and right-side 6 at (3,7) remain unchanged. The leftmost source is 3 at (2,0); it owns originally-zero downstream cells even after crossing an occupied source and gray obstacle. An isolated gray on row 1 produces no ray.

This is **not hand-authored or override-only**: final v2.1.0 `generate(6, 0, difficulty="medium")`, with no overrides, emits exactly this 5x8 input. It passes self_check. Final source SHA-256 `1056cfd90a2ea89d4e95e34ffe4b9f43b922e0590fccdc03ac45414961785241`. Canonical-fit and population details are in `checks/audit/28268c57c367/counterexample.json`.

The exact output was executed with the supported public Racket command from packet_root:
```sh
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 28268c57c367 --input ../checks/audit/28268c57c367/input.json --out ../checks/audit/28268c57c367/racket.json
```
`racket.json` binds the executed and catalog rule hash `b4fa0726be56` and generator SHA, with no approval granted. The diagnostic rival is the actual `CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS["nearest_source"]` function. Other tested canonical-fitting rivals are stopping at isolated gray and overwriting occupied cells. Treating every gray as a source is also plausible from the three demonstrations but fails the already-labeled canonical test, so it is not mislabeled as fitting all canonical pairs.

Final natural rich draws are deliberately constructed to refute these four rivals. The final production census found 0 ambiguous lessons in 300 (100 per band) and 0 ambiguous query rotations in 1,200, using 1,200 unique inputs. Those finite named-rival results do not establish a globally strongest possible rival or unique induction against undeclared alternatives.
